title: Acyclicity of the supported diagonal coefficient under every retraction
statement: For a commutative condensed ring object Lambda, a scheme Y with Noetherian diagonal surface W, and f:W -> P=ProjectiveLine Y satisfying Delta followed by f = id, the full canonical right-derived unit diagonalTraceRightSingle at source Lambda Y is invertible, with the definitions of def-sfb-diagonal-coefficient-category and lem-diagonal-canonical-right-derived.

source.place: Paragraph (1), closed diagonal supported coefficient source; supported-source normalization in the diagonal tower trace

proof.text: For an exact functor G preserving K-injective complexes and an additive functor F with G followed by F naturally isomorphic to the identity, take a K-injective resolution I of a complex K. G sends its resolution map to a quasi-isomorphism; F sends that map to a quasi-isomorphism by the retraction. The right-derived unit of F on G(I) is invertible by K-injective computation. Naturality and cancellation of the two quasi-isomorphisms prove it invertible on G(K).

Apply the preceding argument to the diagonal direct image. It is exact by closed localization. It preserves K-injective complexes because its left adjoint, diagonal inverse image, is exact. Ordinary composition with f is the identity by the given equality Delta f=id. Transfer from the image of a single complex to the single complex on the image through the single-complex comparison. This is precisely invertibility of the canonical diagonalTraceRightSingle.

theorem diagonal_supported_acyclic
    (Λ : Sheaf (coherentTopology Profinite.{u}) Ab.{u + 1})
    [MonObj Λ] [IsCommMonObj Λ] (Y : Scheme.{u})
    [IsNoetherian (diagonalSurface Y)]
    (f : diagonalSurface Y ⟶ ProjectiveLine Y)
    (h : diagonalImmersion Y ≫ f = 𝟙 (ProjectiveLine Y)) :
    IsIso (diagonalTraceRightSingle (CondensedRing.lowerStar Λ f)
      (canonicalDiagonalRightDerived (CondensedRing.lowerStar Λ f)) (source Λ Y))
